caption: The drawing depicts a carved figure of a standing person on a rectangular pedestal. The figure appears to be wearing a feathered headdress with three prominent feathers and has long hair draped down the back. The upper body is adorned with what appears to be a cloak or robe, which is ochre or brownish in color, while the lower part of the figure wears a knee-length, blue-gray skirt. The figure’s right arm is bent at the elbow, holding a bundle that resembles cigars, while the left arm is partially covered by the draped robe. The legs and feet are exposed, with the feet placed firmly apart on the pedestal, which is depicted in shades of dark gray and black with visible lines to indicate texture. The background is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or context. In the bottom right corner of the drawing, there is an artist’s signature that reads “SYD A. ROBERTS” followed by “‘41.”
title: Cigar Store Indian
